Overview
==================
LENS was developed for the `SynSense SPECK™ <https://www.synsense.ai/products/speck-2/>`_, an event-driven neuromorphic System-on-Chip processor
for localization capabilities at the edge.

In particular, LENS was developed with the Speck2f Development Kit. If you have one of these kits, you can deploy models easily and run
the localization network immediately.

.. important::

    While there are multiple development kits available, all of the functions in LENS are **specific** for the Speck2f board and are not
    cross compatible immediately with other hardware.

    Please refer to the `Speck series API reference <https://synsense-sys-int.gitlab.io/samna/0.45.3/devkits/speckSeries/summary.html>`_ for
    information on other development kits.
